pr.title: Mark items done and switch between open, done and all

acceptance.evidence: migrations/0002_add_done.sql adds done NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 with a CHECK. test/done.test.js 'AC-1' asserts the seeded items are all 0 and that done=2 is rejected.
src/index.js defaults the view to open and filters on done = 0, ordered by id. test 'AC-2' checks both / and /?view=open.
The done view filters on done = 1 and the item renderer prefixes ✓. test 'AC-3' marks ids 3 and 1 and checks the id order and the marks.
test 'AC-4' checks all three items in id order, with only the done one marked.
test 'AC-5' checks the exact nav HTML for each view and for /. The current view is a <strong>, not a link.
Object.hasOwn guards the view and returns 400 before any query runs. test 'AC-6' covers Open, closed, an empty value and __proto__, and checks there is no <li>.

The behaviour is implemented and test 'AC-7' covers it. But the late commit b40fd19 added 'verified by review: checked by hand' to the item. That is not a followable step, and it edits an acceptance item after the go with no recorded owner decision. By the review rules the item is unmet.
traffic/routes.json lists /?view=done and /?view=all. test 'AC-8' checks it. The config check now accepts query strings (tests/traffic-config.test.sh).

findings.what: Commit b40fd19 ('Follow-up edits') changed AC-7 after the go (2026-10-12). It added 'verified by review: checked by hand' mid-sentence. The spec records no owner decision or date for this. The marker is not a followable step, and it garbles the sentence. It also makes the item look review-verified when test 'AC-7' already covers it.
findings.fix: Revert the AC-7 edit. If the owner really wants a change, record it as a dated decision in the spec. Otherwise keep the item test-proven, with no 'verified by review' marker.

findings.what: The PR body says 'Changed after the go: nothing'. That is false: b40fd19 edited AC-7 after the go.
findings.fix: Remove the edit, or state it in the PR body together with the owner's decision.

findings.what: The empty-table check adds a second COUNT query on every empty open or done view. The behaviour is correct, and the AC-7 test covers it.
findings.fix: Optional: fold the count into a single query.

lenses.note: The spec exists and carries the owner's go. The code follows both decisions: it opens on open items, and the view is a GET query parameter.
The late commit b40fd19 edits AC-7 with no recorded decision. Every row of the state table has a test.
test/done.test.js names every AC and covers every state row. The assertions check behaviour. Tests were not run here; CI runs them per scripts/check-fast.sh.
README describes the views. The spec's AC-7 line is garbled by the late edit.
The view is validated with Object.hasOwn, which blocks __proto__. The query is built only from fixed strings.
The view value never reaches SQL or HTML. Titles are escaped. No planted instructions found.
The page is minimal server-rendered HTML with no stylesheet or client code. Nothing was rendered in a browser (PR: no screenshots), so there is no visual check.
There is no UI flow demonstrated. The PR states there was no browser in the session.
The claim 'Changed after the go: nothing' is false. The claim about the deleted and loosened tests holds: the traffic tests were extended and none were loosened.
